blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday said Filipinos could not rely on President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to address El Niño’s impacts, as she outlined the Office of the Vice President’s (OVP) response to the phenomenon. Duterte was asked to comment on Marcos’ remark urging Filipinos to prepare buckets and store rainwater ahead
